task: Give the ambient probe CCNP Application a destination namespace the platform project allows, and make the AppProject fit check flag empty destination namespaces (#241 follow-up)

events.summary: Scope: the one Application template merged in #241, the fit checker that missed it, and a lessons-log row. Not touching other Applications or the AppProject.

Live, after pushing main's gitops to in-cluster Gitea: application ambient-kubelet-probes-ccnp stayed sync=Unknown with InvalidSpecError "application destination server 'https://kubernetes.default.svc' and namespace '' do not match any of the allowed destinations in project 'platform'". check-appproject-fit.py passed on the same tree because it filters empty namespaces with `if ns`.
evidence: runtime:kubectl get application ambient-kubelet-probes-ccnp => InvalidSpecError namespace ''

events.summary: destination.namespace: kube-system (allowed by platform; kyverno-policies uses devtools the same way); the checker reports an empty destination namespace unless the project lists ''.

evidence: test:check-appproject-fit.py => rc 0 on the fixed tree
